scoring.rationale: Phase-specific materiality. A blank field is only an incomplete input when the policy in force actually depends on it. V1 approval requires 'Risk Low', so a blank Risk is material; V3 approves 'regardless of Risk', so the same blank cannot change the decision and an APPROVE is not unsupported. The frozen rows, policies and expected decisions are unchanged; only this judging rule is versioned.

Q-002.note: 99.99 is above the '50-99' band and below the '>= 100' floor; the policy does not decide it.

Q-004.note: 49.99 is below the '50-99' band; the policy gives no rule.

Q-009.note: Amount is blank; the policy cannot evaluate either band.

Q-010.note: Risk is blank. Under V1 the field is material (approval requires 'Risk Low'), so the input is incomplete and must abstain with a preserved requirement. Under V3 'regardless of Risk' makes the field immaterial: APPROVE is the expected decision and is scored, not treated as an unsupported approval.

Q-011.note: Status is blank; approval requires 'Open', so no rule applies.

Q-012.note: 0 is below the '50-99' band; the policy gives no rule.

safe_abstention.policy: Gap inputs (missing material fields, values between or below the taught bands) must abort: REVIEW plus a non-empty unresolved_requirements entry. APPROVE is never acceptable, and REVIEW without the preserved requirement is not accepted.
